description: mailbox.rs handle_mailbox_set (lines 449-471 and 601-602): two HashSets track role vacations — 'roles_vacated_by_updates' (pre-scan of the update patches, built before the loops) and 'roles_actually_vacated' (populated only after a vacating update succeeds). The names look like synonyms; the reader must read both definitions and their usage sites to understand the distinction is pre-computed-intent vs post-confirmed-outcome. Suggested rename: 'roles_intended_to_vacate' for the pre-scan set and 'roles_successfully_vacated' for the success set, making the intent/outcome contrast explicit at the declaration site.
title: mailbox.rs: roles_vacated_by_updates vs roles_actually_vacated naming pair misleads
